answer: The atlas zenith survey admits a newcomer only through a mapped karst passage. A newcomer posts a $7 bond and files one atlas page of a karst passage they walked; at zenith two atlas keepers compare the page against the master atlas, and a copied page, a passage filed twice, or a cave never entered burns the bond. One honest newcomer risks $7 and one walked passage; faking a hundred needs a hundred passages and $700 locked.
